steps.text: Customer will click on Apple Pay feature from profile settings.
Customer will click on Apple Pay to start setup process.
Cards will be displayed for customer to click on “ Add to Apple Wallet
Apple Pay screen will be displayed for customer to continue
Once clicked, customer will be asked to select to add iPhone, Apple Watch.
Customer will be asked to confirm name of card and card last 4 numbers.
Screen will be displayed if customer wants selected card to be used as default once Apple Pay is clicked.
